residual_risks.note: sandbox_actions still admits route lifecycle/support actions (allow, disable, remove, profile, evidence_capture) in addition to verify actions; Quick Start itself only wires api_route_check and does not expose those management actions directly.

The evidence pack shows secret_ref only, not the secret value, and the route-check packet is verification-only with sandbox-owned refresh; that behavior is aligned with the contour but should stay covered by regression tests.
